title: Thunder + fiber-optic cabling used for seismic imaging
summary: Thunderstorms make seismic waves that can be used to find sub-surface features.
llm_summary: Scientists have discovered that the acoustic shockwaves generated by lightning‑induced thunder can serve as a natural source of seismic energy. By pairing these thunder‑driven vibrations with existing fiber‑optic cable networks—used as ultra‑sensitive, distributed acoustic sensors—researchers can map underground structures such as rock
